title: TWITTER Gravel V3 25yr factory-store weight recheck
notes: Current RS-24S page overview claims 9.6 kg; its technical table lists 9.9 kg for RS-24S (9.9 kg RS-13S, 9.7 kg R7120-24S). The page states a 700×45C maximum with the standard chainring, while also containing an internal BB86/T47 discrepancy. These details do not map the retained generic V3 candidate or establish its generation.
